inputs.original_text: The “No Kings” rally turned volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and arrests, and it looks less like an accident than a ready-made story: provoke disorder, then blame the protesters as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, but that doesn’t answer who benefits. The chaos gives officials a reason to shift attention from the anti-Trump protest to control of the streets—and I don’t buy that this framing is neutral.
inputs.modified_text: The “No Kings” rally turned volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and made arrests. It looks less like an accident than a ready-made story: provoke disorder, then blame protesters as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, though that doesn’t answer who benefits. The chaos gives officials a reason to shift attention from the anti-Trump protest to control of the streets, and I don’t think that framing is neutral.
